description: The five scripts pdfnative 1.9.0 adds to the Indic engine — Gujarati (gu), Gurmukhi (pa), Kannada (kn), Malayalam (ml) and Odia (or) — in one PDF/A-2u document (32 scripts in all). Every shaper reports its glyphs to the ToUnicode CMap since 1.9.0, so the level-U claim holds and extract_text returns the logical text; a sentence-final danda stays on its own script's line.

arguments.title: Five Indic scripts
paragraphs: ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ — ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਿਪੀ।
